hypotheses.J0_weight_formula_matches_native_vjp: The explicit bilinear-plus-RMSNorm response has relative error at most 1e-5 against the native VJP.
hypotheses.J1_rank256_reconstructs_task_local_respo: First-basis rank 256 reaches at least 0.90 median local-response cosine at every approximated block.
hypotheses.J2_rank256_composes_through_suffix: First-basis rank 256 reaches at least 0.90 median source-gradient cosine at every source layer.
hypotheses.J3_operator_rank64_beats_pca_causally: First-basis rank-64 source-gradient cosine exceeds state-PCA rank 64 by at least 0.02 at every source layer.
hypotheses.J4_operator_rank64_is_finitely_direction: First-basis rank-64 prospective top-64 patches have the correct finite direction on at least 90 percent of sites at every source layer.
hypotheses.J5_independent_operator_bases_agree_caus: Two independent 4096-probe rank-64 programs have median source-gradient cosine at least 0.95 at every source layer.
hypotheses.J6_operator_modes_beat_pca_on_task_respo: At rank 64, operator-aware local response cosine exceeds state PCA in at least four of five approximated blocks.
